{{Quote|I have no doubt that many of my colleagues here have no idea where the Lahara sector is. They couldn't even find it on a map if their careers depended on it&hellip;|Tyreca Bremack|<ref name="hnn 50" />}}
The '''Lahara sector''' was located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] leading up to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist movement]].<ref name="hnn 50" /> The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]<ref name="njosb" /> and the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Gandolo IV/Legends|Gandolo IV]] were located in Lahara sector.<ref name="EAOC" /> The sector contained 245 settled worlds, most of which were primarily agricultural.<ref name="hnn 50" />

The [[Sector/Legends|sector]] bordered the [[Cowl Crucible]] in the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]].<ref name="hnn 56">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|56|regional/13516_1.html|Lahara Patrol Attacked, Jedi to Send Aid}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|OUTER RIM NODE - Separatist extremists opened fire on a Space Rescue Corp patrol cutter on the borders of the Lahara sector yesterday, prompting an emergency Jedi taskforce to be dispatched to the area.|A HoloNet News report|<ref name="hnn 56" />}}
Lahara was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Tyreca Bremack]]. Citing high taxes, the Lahara sector seceded from the Republic shortly before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="hnn 50" />

On 13:5:15, the ''[[Iron Tether]]'', a [[Space Rescue Corps/Legends|Space Rescue Corps]] patrol cutter, was attacked by Separatist extremists while on a routine patrol mission of the Cowl Crucible on the the border of the Lahara sector, prompting a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force led by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Darrin Arkanian]] to be dispatched to the area.<ref name="hnn 56" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the Lahara sector was overseen by an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lahara sector Imperial governor|sector governor]].<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' {{C|Under ''Gandolo IV''}}</ref>
